title: The road in a mirror
logline: The bus's big side mirror from the window seat: 101 going backward in it, the sea on the wrong side. The page draws the route home the only way the sequence allows — reversed, in glass, small.

panels.composition: A bus's large side mirror seen from a window seat with a coastal highway receding in it and the sea on the wrong side, rain on the mirror's edge.
